decisions.reason: The glass flake spraying system extends core two-component know-how at low holding cost, and its corrosion-protection market prospects remain uncertain after two years, so the option stays open.
The low-pressure injection pump is close to the core offer, has a dedicated page, and costs little to maintain, so nothing yet justifies abandonment.
The multi-model transfer pump line uses existing pump expertise and in-house manufacturing, so it is cheap to hold while its value resolves.
Fire protection flow monitoring fits the digitalization strategy in a regulated niche whose value is still unresolved, so keeping this low-cost option is sensible.
The hydraulic two-component spraying system was launched only in 2024 and sits close to the established offer, so uncertainty is high and holding costs are low, which favours keeping it.
